name: Fall Damage
description: Falls hurt {{percent}}% as much as normal. 0 turns fall damage off, the same as everyone wearing Super Shock Absorber.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Fall damage
settings.help: 0 = no fall damage at all. 100 leaves it at stock. Haters take the same fall damage as your fighter, so this applies to them too.

patches.description: Fall damage {{percent}}% of stock (FALL_DMG_BASE and FALL_DMG_INC)
patches.sql: UPDATE master_const_int SET value = value * {{percent}} / 100 WHERE id IN ('FALL_DMG_BASE', 'FALL_DMG_INC');
